main.summary: Download progress snapshot emitted once after the local session is persisted and again after each successfully downloaded and locally persisted extent. An initial snapshot has no latest range and reports the session's current local byte count.

property.name: TransferFamily
property.summary: Transfer family used for the reported progress event.

property.name: Mode
property.summary: Transfer session mode for the progress event.

property.name: Status
property.summary: Transfer status after the reported progress step completed.

property.name: RealizedBytes
property.summary: Total bytes present in the local download after the reported step.

property.name: RemainingBytes
property.summary: Known bytes remaining for a finite segmented download, or null for an open-ended stream-follow download.

property.name: LatestRange
property.summary: The most recent range persisted locally, or null for the initial progress snapshot.

property.name: LatestAppendedLength
property.summary: The source's latest durable appended length observed for stream-follow progress.

property.name: StateVersion
property.summary: Transfer state version after the reported step.
